status: design-contract; no cross-backend executable parity claimed

flag_transport.direct_cli_precedence: explicit spelling overrides mapped env (where backend supports direct flags)

escape_modes.off: Do not run the new escape promotion optimization; preserve mandatory ownership and borrow checks
escape_modes.safe: Only proven semantics-preserving scalar replacement, elision, or stack promotion; unsupported backend rejects
escape_modes.verify: Safe optimization with machine-readable decision evidence, verifier replay, and differential test gates
escape_modes.speculative: Guarded profile-based specialization with proven deoptimization/materialization, requires executable JIT

feature_independence: JIT enablement is independent of escape optimization except speculative requires JIT
required_optimization_proofs: observable allocation and allocator failure semantics preserved
address and pointer identity preserved or allocation demonstrably unobservable
moves borrows aliases and affine drop semantics preserved
all normal unwind panic raise cancellation and early-exit destruction paths preserved
no stack-backed pointer retained through actor message send or channel transport
no invalid stack reference across await select implicit suspension or continuation retirement
FFI callback unsafe and foreign pointers cannot observe vanished storage
native alloca and frame size bounded with no unguarded dynamic alloca
deoptimization materializes values and ownership exactly once before guards transfer control
report provenance bound to binary identity source SHA backend and optimization mode

promotion_gates.admission: real compiler rejects unavailable modes before guest code or artifacts are published
promotion_gates.execution: run positive source workloads with and without optimization and compare outputs and drops
promotion_gates.sanitizers: ASan UBSan and backend-specific lifetime checkers exercised on exact heads
promotion_gates.allocation: allocation and stack frame deltas measured; no elision claims from IR inspection alone
promotion_gates.suspension: actor send, await, cancellation, hot reload, and FFI failure paths executed
promotion_gates.jit: guard miss, deoptimization, reoptimization, and materialization executed for speculative mode
promotion_gates.provenance: record exact build inputs SHA test vectors runner and native binary identity
